function.name: bash-cmd
function.description: Runs an arbitrary Bash shell command: the `script` parameter is passed verbatim as a single argument to bash -c, so pipes, chains (&& / ||), redirections, and quotes all work. The harness execs bash directly (no wrapper shell) and applies no escaping — write the script exactly as you want it parsed. Requires permissions to execute.

script.description: The full bash command/script to execute, verbatim (e.g. `ls -la .clanker/ | head -30 && echo done`).
